name: gear and gearRules on the registry: lab test
description: The in-process half of tools/gear-frontend: a data pack with gear and gearRules (content/gear.json), its equivalent as registry edits (registry/registry.json, which the session puts in content/ in place of gear.json), and a dump at every content ready of the served bytes of every item and of the balancing table (SHA-256, and the table's bytes), the target items' values and registry.json. Writes nothing into the game.
